notice: Agent-drafted authoring proposals for a human chemistry reviewer. None of this is canonical chemistry: nothing here is read by the model, the engines or the renderers, and nothing is added to content-src/chemistry/electrolysis.json until a person authors a record and it passes review as a chemistry assertion.

blackSwanCriterion.rule: >= 2 independent learner choice dimensions with >= 2 modeled values each, and >= 3 distinct cathode/anode outcomes

learnerChoices.why: a low-reactivity metal ion is reduced to the metal; an active-metal ion is not, water is reduced instead
a halide is oxidised to the halogen; an oxo-anion is not, water is oxidised instead

proposedDesign.note: Two independent choices, two values each, four different cathode/anode pairs: no single fixed script reproduces every learner path. CuCl2 is the only combination modeled today.
